stamp.note: Every export carries the stamp of its source data in the export report and a stamp sidecar file. An internally inconsistent stamp (a rating the lane forbids) refuses the export.

consentModel.statement: The character is a consenting adult who wants to experience the scenes and kinks selected for her.

expressions.name: neutral
expressions.semantics: Resting face; the baseline every other state returns to.

expressions.name: smile
expressions.semantics: A warm, pleased smile; eyes soften, mouth corners rise.

expressions.name: joy
expressions.semantics: Open delight; full eye-smile, mouth open, head tilts.

expressions.name: playful
expressions.semantics: Teasing asymmetry; one eye smiles harder, head cants.

expressions.name: surprise
expressions.semantics: Startled; eyes and brows up, mouth open in an O.

expressions.name: sad
expressions.semantics: Downcast; brows slope, mouth corners fall, eyes dim.

expressions.name: angry
expressions.semantics: Cross; brows down hard, mouth pressed flat.

expressions.name: calm
expressions.semantics: Settled; lids low and even, a small settled smile.

trackingSets.title: Standard face + torso tracking set
trackingSets.source: The estate base humanoid template's parameter list (templates/base-humanoid.json): the tracker-ecosystem standard IDs the template itself implements, with the ranges the template declares.

autoAssociation.note: A tracker output whose ID equals a set ID binds to that parameter with no remapping.
Tracker values are clamped to the set ID's declared range on bind.

trackingSets.title: Full-body tracking set (mocopi class)
trackingSets.sourceNote: The full-body set is governed to grow from the published mocopi auto-association list (official nizima LIVE manual). That table was not present in the reference evidence delivered with this phase's commission (the RE report on file ends mid-section, before its nizima inventories), and no ID has been invented to fill it. The set therefore currently carries the face + torso IDs grounded in the estate template, and declares the arms, hands, legs, and feet groups as pending-source with empty ID lists. When the official table is fetched, the groups are filled verbatim and completeness flips to complete; until then any consumer can see the gap in this field instead of discovering it downstream.

arcLadder.label: baseline
arcLadder.scaffold: Establish who she is before anything changes: anchors, refrain, the want stated in her own register.

arcLadder.label: first ask
arcLadder.scaffold: The first stage of the arc is requested by her, in her words; nothing is done to her that she has not asked for.

arcLadder.label: deepening
arcLadder.scaffold: Each stage adds exactly one loss or gain on top of the stages before it; the ladder is cumulative, never a reset.

arcLadder.label: the flip
arcLadder.scaffold: The agency flip sits here, at the arc's structural midpoint: what she asked for begins, by her own account, to ask things of her.

arcLadder.label: the old frame retires
arcLadder.scaffold: The authored rupture line lands at this slot, verbatim, in her voice; the old frame is named as it goes.

arcLadder.label: the new normal
arcLadder.scaffold: The endpoint is a settled state she inhabits fully, not an emptied one; the refrain returns, character-exact, to close.
